This strongly suggests a shared concept of a playlist entry that carries an identity, an hour, a chronological order ID, and a creation timestamp. Rather than a generic-parameterization (the types are semantically distinct domain concepts, not interchangeable), the idiomatic Swift approach is to introduce a protocol — tentatively named `PlaylistEntry` — that formalises the shared initialisation contract and the implied stored properties (`id`, `hour`, `chronOrderID`, `timeCreated`), allowing all three conforming types to satisfy it. This eliminates the structural duplication while preserving each type's distinct identity and any type-specific behaviour.
